title: JSWElectricalInventoryDatabase
description: Core Database Schema for JSW Plant Electrical Department Inventory System

users.description: Authorized employees master list for authentication and access control

Employee_ID.description: Unique identifier for the employee (Primary Key)

Full_Name.description: Full name of the employee as provisioned by the Administrator

inventory.description: Consumable electrical materials catalog with current stock levels

Item_ID.description: Unique identifier for the inventory item (Primary Key)

Item_Name.description: Descriptive name of the electrical consumable item

Current_Stock_Level.description: Current stock quantity in storage. Can temporarily be negative during offline sync reconciliation.

binningLocation.description: Physical shelf, rack, or bin location for the item. Defaults to '-' if unspecified.

transactions.description: Ledger of checkout transactions recorded by employees and synced to the database

Transaction_ID.description: Unique identifier for the transaction (Primary Key / UUID)

Employee_ID.description: Employee ID of the individual checking out the item (Foreign Key -> Users.Employee_ID)

Item_ID.description: Item ID of the consumable material being checked out (Foreign Key -> Inventory.Item_ID)

Quantity_Taken.description: Quantity of the item taken during checkout or returned to shelf

Transaction_Type.description: Type of material transaction: CHECKOUT (outgoing) or RETURN (returned unused parts)

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp representing exact transaction time

Sync_Status.description: True if synced to the central server; False if pending offline sync queue
